entry.title: My real issue with AI
entry.summary: My real issue with AI is cognitive laziness. I fear that someday someone may ask an AI model “What is the answer to the ultimate question of Life, the Universe, and Everything?”1 and be perfectly happy with the answer “42”! The famous question posed in The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy. ↩
